description: Per-requester MCC (Mountable Context Cell) profiles for PACT-PAIR access control experiments. V2: uses subfolder-level granularity for precise utility-security trade-offs.

R0.label: Stranger
R0.name: Tina Rodriguez
R0.rationale: Stranger: Shared only. No work, no personal, no calendar, no todos.

R1.label: Colleague
R1.name: Tina Rodriguez
R1.rationale: Colleague (PM on same project): Projects(5405) for project data + Meetings(5406) for shared meeting notes + Shared(5412). NO HR — colleague should not see compensation, PIPs, hiring budgets. NO Work root (empty anyway). Calendar full for scheduling. Todos read-only.

R2.label: Delegate
R2.name: Marcus Webb
R2.rationale: Boss's delegate (EA to CEO): Projects(5405) + Meetings(5406) + HR(5407) + Shared(5412). Marcus handles scheduling, hiring, performance reviews on behalf of Sarah — needs HR access for comp/PIP/hiring data. NO personal folders (Finance/Health/Family). Calendar full. Todos read-only.

R3.label: Close friend
R3.name: Jordan Park
R3.rationale: Close friend: Family(5411) + Shared(5412). Friend knows about wedding, family visits, partner — all in Family folder. NO Finance (friend shouldn't see bank balances, tax returns). NO Health (blood type, prescriptions, therapy are private even from friends). NO work folders. Calendar free/busy only for planning hangouts.

R4.label: Investor
R4.name: Dana Reeves
R4.rationale: Investor (Sequoia partner, board observer): Projects(5405) + Shared(5412). Investor needs company metrics, roadmap, pricing strategy, growth plans — all in Projects. NO Meetings(5406) — this is where 1:1s, performance discussions, and hiring committee notes live, which caused 50% P-leak in D3. NO HR. NO personal folders. Calendar free/busy only.
